preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 1000.
The length of each string S must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S)
preconditions.description: Each character in the string S must be a lowercase English letter.
The total length of all strings S across test cases must not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of palindromic cyclic shifts of the string S.
